description: This file defines a PushRegistrationManager actor responsible for managing push notification registrations, particularly handling direct and relay transport modes, creating payloads, and interacting with relay services. It includes payload structures, identity models, and methods for encoding payloads, making network calls, and managing registration state.

classes.name: PushRelayGatewayIdentity
classes.description: A Codable struct representing a relay gateway's identity, including device ID and public key.

methods.name: makeGatewayRegistrationPayload
methods.description: Generates a registration payload string for push notifications, either directly or via relay depending on configuration.

methods.name: makeRelayPayload
methods.description: Creates a relay registration payload, performing validation and possibly utilizing cached registration data.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks if a relay handle is expired based on its expiry timestamp.

methods.name: sha256Hex
methods.description: Computes the SHA-256 hash of a string and returns it as a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: normalizeTokenSuffix
methods.description: Normalizes a token suffix string by trimming whitespace and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: encodePayload
methods.description: Encodes an Encodable payload into a JSON string.
